title: TopicMerge: A Divide and Conquer Approach to Topic Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.19323v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advancements in topic modeling have split into two main paths: efficient embedding-based methods that offer scalability but are often outperformed on standard clustering metrics, and Large Language Model (LLM) approaches that achieve state-of-the-art clustering performance but at the cost of prohibitive computational expense and poor scalability. This paper introduces TopicMerge, a novel multi-stage pipeline that bridges these approaches to achieve both state-of-the-art clustering performance and computational efficiency. TopicMerge first employs an efficient clustering pipeline to deliberately over-segment a document corpus into a large set of fine-grained, semantically pure micro-clusters, which are then given initial semantic labels. translated_title: TopicMerge：一种分而治之的主题建模方法
translated_abstract: 主题建模领域的最新进展分化为两条主要路径：高效的基于嵌入的方法具有良好的可扩展性，但在标准聚类指标上往往表现不佳；而大语言模型（LLM）方法虽然实现了最先进的聚类性能，但代价是高昂的计算开销和较差的可扩展性。本文提出了TopicMerge，这是一种新颖的多阶段流水线，它将上述两种方法结合起来，以同时实现最先进的聚类性能和计算效率。TopicMerge首先采用高效的聚类流水线，有意识地将文档语料库过度分割为大量细粒度、语义纯净的微聚类，并为这些微聚类赋予初始语义标签。随后，它引入了一种新颖的迭代合并算法，由LLM在局部邻域上下文的引导下，对候选合并对进行仲裁决策。这些被批准的合并随后被有选择地……
tldr: TopicMerge提出一种分治式的多阶段流水线，先通过高效聚类将文档过度分割为语义纯净的微聚类，再由LLM结合局部邻域上下文迭代仲裁合并候选对，从而同时实现了最先进的聚类性能与计算效率。
en_tdlr: TopicMerge is a divide-and-conquer multi-stage pipeline that first over-segments a corpus into semantically pure micro-clusters via efficient clustering, then uses an LLM guided by local neighborhood context to iteratively arbitrate merges, achieving both state-of-the-art clustering performance and computational efficiency.
